clue.text: Start to probe spasm in people? That's the doctor's business

indicators.note: the start of the word probe supplies its opening letter here
in places the spasm inside the word for people

parts.note: a race is a people or nation
a tic is an involuntary muscle spasm

explanation.surface: A clinic's work begins with probing a twitch in a patient population.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor's practice is the professional business or surgery a physician runs.

clue.text: Self-confidence of a male, outwardly quiet and shy

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

indicators.note: outwardly says the quiet and shy pieces sit on the outside, wrapping the male

parts.note: to shy is to throw, as is to lob

explanation.surface: A man who seems quiet and shy on the outside may still have inner self-assurance.
explanation.definitionFit: Aplomb is poise and assurance, a synonym for self-confidence.

clue.text: Hippy, as it's turned out, engages alternative health worker

indicators.note: engages means takes on board, so one piece holds the other within it
turned out suggests the letters of the preceding words have been rearranged

parts.note: the letters of these words as written
other means alternative, as in the other option

explanation.surface: A hippy, as things transpire, consults a practitioner of alternative medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned out' rearranges HIPPYASITS into PHYSIAPIST, and 'engages' puts OTHER inside it. 'alternative' looks like it qualifies 'health worker' but it supplies OTHER.
explanation.definitionFit: A physiotherapist treats injuries with exercise and manipulation, a kind of health worker.

clue.text: Shabby affair: nationalist implicated in revolutionary movement

parts.note: a do is a party or social affair

indicators.note: implicated in means involved within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a wheel turns round and round, a revolving movement

explanation.surface: A seedy business in which a nationalist is mixed up in a revolutionary cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' suggests politics alongside 'nationalist', but it describes something that goes round and round.
explanation.definitionFit: Down at heel describes someone or something run-down and shabby in appearance.

clue.text: College based in Whitechapel

indicators.note: based in says the answer sits inside the letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A college located in the East London district of Whitechapel.
explanation.definitionFit: Tech is a short informal name for a technical college.

clue.text: Charlie, trendy male occupying flat

indicators.note: occupying means living within, so the trendy and male pieces go inside the flat

parts.note: a pad is slang for a flat or home
in means fashionable, trendy
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A fashionable man has moved into Charlie's apartment.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a 'charlie' is a fool, not a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are informal British insults for a stupid person or idiot.

clue.text: A Latin way, not quite right for high-flier

parts.note: via is the Latin word for road or way

indicators.note: not quite means the word falls short by its final letter

parts.note: a Tory is a right-winger

explanation.surface: Taking a Latin road, not quite correct, for an ambitious person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not quite' drops the last letter of TORY, leaving TOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An aviator flies aircraft, so is literally someone who flies high.

clue.text: Between two acts played old musical composition

indicators.note: between puts the old letter among the letters of the other piece
played suggests the acts are performed in a new order

parts.note: the word act taken twice

explanation.surface: An old piece of music performed in the interval between two acts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'played' rearranges ACTACT into TCCATA, and 'Between' sets O after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A toccata is a virtuoso keyboard piece, a type of musical composition.

clue.text: Son and girl reserving time for chat line?

indicators.note: reserving means keeping something inside, so the girl holds the time letter

parts.note: chick is slang for a girl

explanation.surface: A son and a girl book a slot on a telephone chat line.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on a comedian's patter: a schtick is a routine of chat and lines.
explanation.definitionFit: A schtick is a performer's routine or patter, the line of talk they use.

clue.text: Sort of economy that's not good for bank

indicators.note: that's not says the following letter is missing from the word

parts.note: a tiger economy is a fast-growing one, such as those of East Asia

explanation.surface: A kind of economy that is bad for a bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks financial but means a row or level, as in a bank of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier and a bank are both a row or level arranged one above another.

clue.text: Rifle we'll load in case row's beginning

indicators.note: load means fill something, so the other pieces are put inside it

parts.note: the word we, with the 'll merely making it future
a chest is a box or case

indicators.note: beginning picks out the first letter of the word row

explanation.surface: We will put a rifle in its case at the start of the row.
explanation.walkthrough: The contraction 'we'll' gives just WE; the 'll' is surface grammar for the future.
explanation.definitionFit: The Winchester is a famous make of repeating rifle.

clue.text: What buttoned-up type might reveal? Please don't take offence

definitions.meaning: a reserved person discloses nothing about themselves
a stock phrase asking someone not to be hurt by a remark

explanation.definitionFit: A buttoned-up person reveals no personal details; the stock phrase reassures that no slight was meant.

clue.text: Musical instrument's my bag

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like my!
a net is a bag for carrying things, or a catch

explanation.surface: Someone declaring that a musical instrument belongs in their bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my' is an exclamation, not a possessive: COR is a British cry of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A cornet is a brass instrument like a small trumpet.

clue.text: Companion in first eleven finally abandoned drink

parts.note: china is Cockney rhyming slang (china plate, mate) for a companion

indicators.note: finally abandoned says the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a sports team's first eleven is its team

explanation.surface: A teammate in the first eleven quit drinking at last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally abandoned' drops the last letter of TEAM, leaving TEA. China for mate is Cockney rhyming slang.
explanation.definitionFit: China tea is a type of tea, a hot drink brewed from Chinese leaves.

clue.text: Very good youngster editor introduced became vocal

parts.note: pi is slang for pious, very good

indicators.note: introduced means brought inside, so the editor goes into the youngster

parts.note: a pup is a young dog, or a cheeky youngster

explanation.surface: A well-behaved youngster, brought in by an editor, started to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: To pipe up is to start speaking, to become vocal suddenly.

clue.text: Woman calmly ignores the odds

indicators.note: ignores the odds means drop the odd-numbered letters, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A woman calmly brushes aside long odds.
explanation.definitionFit: Amy is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Concerning several parties subsequently appearing in court case

indicators.note: appearing in means one piece shows up inside the other

parts.note: a trial is a case heard in court
later means subsequently

explanation.surface: Something affecting several parties that later turns up in a lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: Trilateral agreements involve three sides, that is several parties.

clue.text: Hear song clip

definitions.meaning: to grasp a sound, as in I didn't quite get that
a round for several voices sung in turn
a fastening such as a latch or clasp

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to hear, a sung round, and a clasp or fastener.

clue.text: Top dog, you say?

indicators.note: you say signals that the word is said out loud and heard as another

parts.note: a Peke is a Pekingese dog

explanation.surface: Asking whether a dog is the top dog.
explanation.walkthrough: PEKE (a Pekingese) is pronounced the same as the word for a summit.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak is the top of a mountain, the summit.

clue.text: Surprise revelation at end of Hardy novel?

indicators.note: at end of says this piece comes after the next one

parts.note: Oliver Hardy was the comic partner in Laurel and Hardy
a twist is a surprise turn in a story

explanation.surface: A shock ending to one of Thomas Hardy's novels.
explanation.walkthrough: Hardy suggests the novelist Thomas Hardy, but it is Oliver Hardy of Laurel and Hardy.
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver Twist is the famous novel by Charles Dickens.

clue.text: Save a hundred animals, spared from start of drastic slaughter

parts.note: but means except, save
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: spared from means a letter is let off or removed from the animals

parts.note: a herd is a group of animals

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of drastic

explanation.surface: Saving a hundred animals from a drastic slaughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spared from' removes D, the start of drastic, from HERD, leaving HER.
explanation.definitionFit: To butcher is to slaughter brutally, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Some Swiss dope meets typical Welshman?

parts.note: gen and dope are both slang for information
Evans is a very common Welsh surname

explanation.surface: Some Swiss drug meets a stereotypical Welshman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like a drug but means information.
explanation.definitionFit: Genevans are people from Geneva, so some Swiss.

clue.text: Turn cold? Warmer garment found

parts.note: to wind is to turn, as with a key
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
a heater is something that warms

explanation.surface: Weather turning chilly calls for a warmer piece of clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A windcheater is a windproof jacket, a garment.

clue.text: Working at end of the main holiday period

indicators.note: at end of says this piece is placed after the next

parts.note: the main is an old term for the open sea, the high seas
on means working, as a machine is on

explanation.surface: Working until the end of the main holiday season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is a poetic term for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: High season is the busiest part of the year for holidays.

clue.text: Director initially oversees film studio's business

indicators.note: oversees in a down clue means sits above, so this piece comes first
initially picks out the first letter of the word director

parts.note: Ealing Studios in west London is a famous film studio

explanation.surface: A director first oversees the film studio's business dealings.
explanation.walkthrough: Ealing is a famous film studio in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Dealings are business transactions or affairs.

clue.text: Giant bird panics, having wings clipped

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird

indicators.note: having wings clipped means the outer letters are cut off the word

explanation.surface: A huge bird panics after having its wings clipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Titanic means colossal, as huge as a giant.

clue.text: River runs into a lake, I fancy, in European province

indicators.note: runs into means flows inside, so the river goes into the other letters
fancy, as in imagine or elaborate, signals the letters being reworked

explanation.surface: A river flowing into a lake, I suppose, in a European region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' rearranges ALAKEI into KAELIA, and 'runs into' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Karelia is a region on the Russian-Finnish border, a European province.

clue.text: Republican unknown in churches

indicators.note: in places the unknown inside the churches

parts.note: CE (Church of England) and CH are both abbreviations for a church
Z is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: A Republican of no known identity inside churches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Republican' is not the US party: it is a citizen of the Czech Republic.
explanation.definitionFit: A Czech is a citizen of the Czech Republic, so a republican.

clue.text: Ill-feeling upset English politician

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so read bottom to top

parts.note: Lib is short for a Liberal politician

explanation.surface: Bad feeling has upset an English politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Bile is bitterness or anger, an ill-feeling.

clue.text: Fruit container turned over

indicators.note: turned over in a down clue means flipped so it reads backwards

parts.note: a tun is a large cask, a container

explanation.surface: A fruit bowl that has been turned over.
explanation.definitionFit: A nut is a hard-shelled fruit.
